description: A standalone verification of the existing first-way intermediate inference: the three explicit act/potency laws imply that a subject being moved in a respect cannot move itself in that same respect. No motion premise is supplied for a merely existing or modally contingent subject; there is no blanket ban on intrinsic explanation, cross-respect activity or temporally separated feedback. The source is the already registered ST I q.2 a.3 first-way reading, materialized and reread without changing its claims. This connects existing statements; every philosophical premise remains open and no root premise is discharged. See docs/power-existence-scope-boundary.md.
